name: xovis-sdk
description: Unofficial Xovis Hardware integration via MCP that seamlessly bridges the Xovis Python SDK to autonomous AI agents. Features zero-trust pseudonymization, human-in-the-loop safety guardrails, and unlocks the full suite of 261 tools (including analytics, datapush, and system commands) when configured with correct device/hub credentials.
